name: Szalonna (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szalonna: a green shield with a yellow ear of grain and a bunch of grapes, with a helm, a grey eagle crest and grey mantling, above a scroll inscribed SZALONNA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szalonna arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
